blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Thursday urged Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) member states and their dialogue partners to reject threats or the use of force and uphold international law as maritime tensions persist in the region. Teodoro stressed that regional defense cooperation must be grounded in mutual respect and adherence to international law, including the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos). “Asean member states and dialogue partners share the same principles, such as respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, non-interference in internal affairs, the peaceful settlement of disputes, and the renunciation of […]...
